text:
mira: heads up — onboarding run for zephyr-lite-7b finished on canary ~15m ago. seeing two issues: sampling degeneracy on open prompts (short repetitive lines) + p99 latency bumped ~30%. posting quick examples and metrics.

olivia: deploy-bot: rolled canary zephyr-lite-7b @ canary-3 (rev: z7b-2026-03-20) :white_check_mark:

aj: examples pls

mira: example output and metrics: 
```
User: Tell a story about a dragon.
Model: I agree. I agree. I agree. I agree. I agree. I agree.
```
quick eval metrics (1k prompts): avg_entropy=5.8 (baseline 7.2), repeat_rate=4.6% (baseline 0.3%), p50=85ms p95=220ms p99=340ms (baseline p99=260ms)

tomas: is this q4f16 or q8? which kernel and sampler version?

mira: rolled q4f16 + per-channel symmetric; fused-attn enabled; sampler=v2 (custom annealing). batch config: autoscale default (burst up to 8). KV cache behavior: normal (no rewrites).

aj: quick repro command to run locally: 
```
./run_infer --model zephyr-lite-7b --variant q4f16 --kernel fused-attn --sampler v2 --batch 8 --trace /tmp/trace.json
```

olivia: I've created a console trace and linked it in the ticket: https://console.internal/runs/zephyr-lite-7b/canary-3/trace/2149901234

devex: also saw eval drift when we compare batch=1 vs batch=8 — short truncation tends to happen under larger batching. could be sampler+batch interaction. try disabling fused-attn or revert sampler.

mira: will run the local repro now and flip fused-attn off / sampler=v1. if reproduces, we'll rollback to previous variant z7b-2026-03-19.

incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-187 (priority=P2). assigned: aj, tomas.

aj: quick hypothesis: sampler v2 has an annealing edge-case when combined with fused-attn's kv-prefetch path; results in token-prob undershoot -> collapse. repro plan: run sampler v1 + fused-attn off, then try sampler v2 + fused-attn off, then v2 + fused-attn on with batch=1.

tomas: :thumbsup: i'll run v1 sampler + disable fused-attn on canary and post traces.

mira: thanks — ETA 30m. adding eval logs and sample set to the incident ticket.

aj: if urgent rollback needed, we should revert model variant and re-enable previous canary scale (z7b-2026-03-19). i'll coordinate with infra.

mira: noted. pinging infra after I attach traces.

(END)
